planSteps.description: Open /#/town and wait for the saved audit to load. Do not press "Check the town now" and do not follow any ↗ link: they leave the site
Assert the tile "Record citations checked" shows 1,051 and the tile "Contradicted by the record" shows 9
Scroll to the section headed "What the record contradicts"
Assert the section lists 9 flagged citations

Assert the first flagged citation shows the resident's name, a "Post ↗" link, a sentence saying which detail differs from the record, a box with the record's own text, and a link "The signed record ↗"
